instruction: Explain the concept of LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) in fine-tuning large language models.
output: LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) is an efficient fine-tuning technique that freezes pre-trained model weights and injects trainable rank decomposition matrices into each layer of the Transformer architecture, significantly reducing trainable parameters and VRAM requirements.

### Instruction:
Explain the concept of LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) in fine-tuning large language models.

### Response:
LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) is an efficient fine-tuning technique that freezes pre-trained model weights and injects trainable rank decomposition matrices into each layer of the Transformer architecture, significantly reducing trainable parameters and VRAM requirements.

instruction: Summarize the key benefits of QLoRA 4-bit quantization.
output: QLoRA combines 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4) quantization with double quantization and paged optimizers, allowing 33B+ or 70B parameter models to be fine-tuned on a single consumer GPU without sacrificing accuracy.
